title: Percy Jackson Co-Creator Teases Season 3 Plot Amid Season 2 Release - NewsBreak
text:
By Devanshi Basu ,
2 hours ago Photo Credit: Disney+ Percy Jackson and the Olympians Season 3 is already being teased, with co-creator Rick Riordan giving new details about where the story is heading as Season 2 releases on Disney+.
What did Rick Riordan say about Percy Jackson and the Olympians Season 3? Riordan confirmed that Percy and Annabeth’s relationship will continue to transform in Percy Jackson and the Olympians Season 3. He emphasized how the onscreen version amplifies emotional moments from the books. “As the kids say, it hits different when it’s on the screen,” he said, noting that scenes written subtly in the novels become more intense visually (via Variety ).
Because of that, the writers remain committed to maintaining the slow-burn nature of their bond. “It’s important that we honor the source material story… Are they going to be more than friends? We don’t know, and that’s not going to be answered for quite a while.” He added a direct tease for Percy Jackson Season 3: “And, oh, boy, wait till you see the third season.”
Riordan acknowledged that the series introduced slightly more romantic undertones between Percy and Annabeth in Season 1 than the novels did. But he clarified that neither character is aware of having a crush at this stage. According to him, their emotional confusion remains consistent with the story’s timeline.
Riordan explained, “It is skewed a bit by the fact that the actors are growing up… But seeing them be as much older as they are from Season 1, and then again in Season 3, it does skew our understanding of what might be going on in their heads.”
He added that Percy and Annabeth are still overwhelmed by the dangers around them. “They are still so conflicted, so much in crisis mode… I think there’s a lot of denial going on. A lot of fear. ‘There’s so much already on our plate. I can’t even think to go there right now.’”
All in all, Riordan’s tease promises that the duo’s evolving bond will remain a compelling heart of the series as it sails toward future adventures.
